newsitem.title: USA: China Tire stake held by HK-based group.
newsitem.headline: China Tire stake held by HK-based group.

text.p: A group including China Strategic Holdings Ltd said Monday it holds 413,500 common shares of China Tire Holdings Ltd, representing 6.89 percent of the class outstanding.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it also holds 3.0 million shares, or 100 percent, of China Tire's "supervoting" common stock, each of which is convertible into one common share.

The group said its stake includes 201,700 shares bought between November 29 and December 4 at prices ranging from $8.00 to $10.00 a share. Those purchases were made by Kamthorn Ltd, a unit of CSH, it said.
China Tire and CSH are both based in Hong Kong. CSH is controlled by Singaporean investor Oei Hong Leong, the firm's chairman and chief executive, according to the filing.
